frozen_rules: ADR-1 OS byte-range lock on a never-unlinked lock file
ADR-2 one non-nested lock; lock_budget_for(x)=min(x,60); timeout => fail closed => lease_lock_timeout
ADR-3 last release + resume decision inside ONE critical section; empty refcount never authorises resume
ADR-4 lease_id + process incarnation; removal only by lease_id; unknown liveness => fail closed
ADR-5 crash windows W1-W8 fail closed
ADR-6 no new budget; lease layer only consumes phase budget
ADR-7 owner marker unchanged; refcount schema filing-fetch.pause-refcount/2; legacy list => fail closed unless FILING_FETCH_PAUSE_LEASE_MIGRATE=1
ADR-8 user pause intent wins when not attributable to us
ADR-9/9b/9c paused-or-lease branch before the runtime_state guard; one pause per cycle; reclaim dead first
ADR-10 R1-R5 branch table for the last release
ADR-10e a leaving owner transfers ownership to a surviving lease
ADR-11 the whole acquire path is ONE critical section
ADR-12 generation is a per-file counter, restarts at 1
